Class JSONUtils.SObjectExtended

public class JSONUtils.SObjectExtended
extends Tools.SObjectEnhanced

Extended SObject wrapper class that facilitates mapping JSON data to Salesforce SObjects. Provides type-safe methods for setting field values from JSON records with support for data transformations, default values, and external ID handling.

private Boolean putBooleanValue(JSONUtils.MappingField mapping)

Maps a boolean field value from JSON record using field mapping configuration. Retrieves value from JSON, applies default if needed, and converts to boolean.

Parameters:
    mapping – Field mapping configuration containing JSON path and transformation rules.

Returns:
    The boolean value set, or null if unable to determine value.

private Datetime putDatetimeValue(JSONUtils.MappingField mapping)

Maps a datetime field value from JSON record using field mapping configuration. Retrieves value from JSON, applies default if needed, and parses according to datetime format.

Parameters:
    mapping – Field mapping configuration containing JSON path, datetime format, and transformation rules.

Returns:
    The datetime value set, or null if unable to parse.

private Decimal putDecimalValue(JSONUtils.MappingField mapping)

Maps a decimal/numeric field value from JSON record using field mapping configuration. Retrieves value from JSON, applies default if needed, optionally multiplies by scaling factor, and captures as external ID if configured.

Parameters:
    mapping – Field mapping configuration containing JSON path, scaling factor, and transformation rules.

Returns:
    The decimal value set, or null if unable to parse.

private String putStringValue(JSONUtils.MappingField mapping)

Maps a string field value from JSON record using field mapping configuration. Retrieves value from JSON, applies default if needed, optionally capitalizes, performs cross-reference lookups, validates against allowed values, and captures as external ID if configured.

Parameters:
    mapping – Field mapping configuration containing JSON path, validation rules, and transformation settings.

Returns:
    The string value set (with prefix if applicable), or null if validation fails or value unavailable.

public Object putValue(JSONUtils.MappingField mapping)

Sets a field value based on mapping configuration with type-safe handling. Automatically determines the field type and applies appropriate transformation.

Parameters:
    mapping – The field mapping configuration.

Returns:
    The value set, or null if unable to set.
